notes: 100% free via p004 HRD Corp e-LATiH (19,129 learners enrolled) with completion certificate. (马来文授课的职场安全标识与职业安全基础免费课，时长40分钟)

title: Business Chinese 1 中级汉语（上）
skills: communication; communicate with customers
sdg_reason: Enhances intermediate Mandarin business communication skills for workplace and commercial settings (SDG 8.5).
summary: Shanghai Jiao Tong University 5-module Mandarin course covering HSK Level 3-5 vocabulary, grammar, business travel, and workplace dialogues.
notes: Taught in Mandarin (Simplified Chinese); free to audit or free certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass. (上海交通大学全中文授课中级商务汉语课，可通过p002免费考证)

title: Learning Chinese : Start From Scratch (零到一學中文)
skills: communication; communicate with customers
sdg_reason: Builds practical everyday and service-sector Mandarin conversation skills for beginners (SDG 8.5).
summary: National Taiwan University 6-module introductory course taught in Mandarin covering greetings, self-introduction, shopping, ordering, transit, and daily dialogues.
notes: Taught in Mandarin (Traditional Chinese, 6 modules / ~5-6 hrs); free to audit or free certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass. (台湾大学全中文授课零基础实用中文会话课，可通过p002免费考证)

title: Introduction to Data Science
skills: perform data analysis; principles of artificial intelligence
sdg_reason: Provides free bilingual entry-level data science and AI/ML literacy training for aspiring data professionals (SDG 8.2).
summary: Self-paced 6-hour Cisco course (4 modules, 5 labs) covering data collection, big data pipelines, AI/machine learning fundamentals, and data careers.
notes: 100% free on Cisco NetAcad; fully offered in Simplified Chinese (中文简体) and English with digital badge. (思科网院官方免费数据科学导论课，提供简体中文完整版本与5个实操实验)

title: Operating Systems Basics
skills: administer ICT system; ensure information security
sdg_reason: Equips Chinese- and English-speaking learners with foundational Windows, Linux, and mobile OS administration skills (SDG 8.5).
summary: Self-paced 12-hour Cisco course (4 modules, 18 labs) covering Windows configuration, Linux shell and file systems, Android/iOS connectivity, and OS security.
notes: 100% free on Cisco NetAcad; fully offered in Simplified Chinese (中文简体) and English with digital badge. (思科网院官方免费操作系统基础课，含Windows/Linux与18个实验，支持简体中文)

title: Introduction to IoT and Digital Transformation
skills: computer programming; cloud technologies
sdg_reason: Develops foundational Internet of Things, Python prototyping, and automation skills for industrial digitization (SDG 8.2).
summary: Self-paced 6-hour Cisco course (6 modules) covering IoT network connectivity, Blockly and Python programming, big data storage, AI automation, and IoT security.
notes: 100% free on Cisco NetAcad; fully offered in Simplified Chinese (中文简体) and English with completion badge. (思科网院官方免费物联网与数字化转型导论课，支持简体中文完整版本)

title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
skills: principles of artificial intelligence; utilise machine learning
sdg_reason: Provides free multilingual cloud AI and generative AI technical education for career transitioners.
summary: Self-paced Microsoft Learn curriculum (2 learning paths, 14 modules) covering AI concepts, machine learning, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, and Azure Foundry.
notes: Online learning modules are 100% free in Simplified/Traditional Chinese and English; official AI-900/AI-901 exam costs USD 99. (微软官方免费Azure AI基础学习路径，支持简繁中文，考证需另付费)

title: Solar Energy Basics
skills: solar energy; photovoltaic systems; alternative energy
sdg_reason: Builds entry-level solar knowledge for workers moving into renewable energy jobs.
summary: State University of New York 5-module course on how solar power works, sizing a small PV system, the solar market and solar careers.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise.

title: Solar Energy System Design
skills: photovoltaic systems; types of photovoltaic panels; design solar energy systems
sdg_reason: Gives hands-on PV design skills needed for solar engineering and installation roles.
summary: State University of New York 5-module course on PV module and array circuits, shading and temperature losses, and designing a grid-tied system.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise. Best taken after Solar Energy Basics.

title: Energy management for real estate. Methods and digital tools
skills: conduct energy audit; energy efficiency; energy performance of buildings; analyse energy consumption
sdg_reason: Teaches building energy audits and efficiency measures used by energy managers and assessors.
summary: Politecnico di Milano 4-module course on the energy manager role, building energy audits, efficiency upgrades, renewables and digital energy models.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise. Module times add up to about 4 hours; the page rounds to 5.

title: Municipal Solid Waste Management in Developing Countries
skills: waste management; advise on waste management procedures
sdg_reason: Prepares learners for waste and recycling jobs in low- and middle-income countries like Malaysia.
summary: EPFL 5-module course on waste collection and governance, organic waste treatment, special waste streams and city waste planning.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise.

title: Introduction to Environmental Law and Policy
skills: environmental legislation; pollution legislation; environmental policy
sdg_reason: Builds the legal and policy knowledge environmental and recycling specialists need for compliance work.
summary: University of North Carolina 7-module course on how law handles pollution, water, air, toxic substances, endangered species and climate change.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise. Examples are mostly US law; the principles carry over.

title: Corporate Sustainability. Understanding and Seizing the Strategic Opportunity
skills: corporate sustainability; sustainable development goals; promote sustainability
sdg_reason: Equips managers to lead sustainability and CSR work inside companies.
summary: Università Bocconi 6-module course on the SDGs, the business case for sustainability, and how to steer a company through a sustainability transition.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise.

title: The Age of Sustainable Development
skills: sustainable development goals; promote environmental awareness
sdg_reason: Gives a broad grounding in the SDGs for anyone moving into green or social-impact work.
summary: Columbia University 15-module course on poverty, inequality, planetary boundaries, climate, cities, health and the SDGs.
notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise.

title: Sustainability Reporting: From Regulation to Implementation
skills: global standards for sustainability reporting; lead the sustainability reporting process; measure company's sustainability performance
sdg_reason: Trains CSR and finance staff to produce the ESG reports that listed companies must publish.

notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise. Intermediate level.

title: Reshaping our Economies
skills: sustainable finance; promote sustainability
sdg_reason: Explains how a just green transition changes jobs, policy and finance.

notes: Free self-paced e-course by UNDP, UNEP, ILO, UNIDO and UNITAR (PAGE); the optional UN certificate costs USD 30 after passing the final quiz. Also in Spanish and French.

title: ESG Practices and Governance in the Workplace

notes: Paid Premium Course (RM90.00) on HRD Corp e-LATiH with completion certificate. The page does not state the language; title and description are in English (same provider as c026).

title: SQL for Data Science
skills: query languages; use databases

notes: Free with certificate via p002 Global Learning Pass; paid subscription required otherwise.

title: Data Visualization and Communication with Tableau
